zh-Hans:
· 修复：打完字立即重命名、移动或删除文件时，内容可能被写回原来的位置
· 修复：关闭专注模式后文字仍然是淡的；设置窗口在前台时按 ⌘W 会关掉文档标签页
· 修复：GBK 编码的中文文件导入后乱码；名字带点的双链打不开；双链补全只列出前 50 个笔记
· 导出：EPUB、LaTeX、Word 多处修正；导出 HTML 和复制为 HTML 时保留双链与公式
· 安全：预览的内容过滤更严格；点击指向应用或脚本的链接前先确认；应用内更新要求同一开发者的 Apple 证书
· 备份：子文件夹暂时读不了时不再删除远端备份；恢复支持 KMS 加密的存储桶
· 重命名或移动文件后，历史版本仍然可以查看
en:
· Fixed: typing and then immediately renaming, moving or deleting a file could write the text back to the old location.
· Fixed: text stayed dimmed after turning off Focus Mode; ⌘W closed a document tab while the Settings window was in front.
· Fixed: Chinese GBK files were garbled on import; wiki links to names containing dots didn't open; wiki link completion only offered the first 50 notes.
· Export: several EPUB, LaTeX and Word fixes; HTML export and Copy as HTML now keep wiki links and math.
· Security: stricter preview sanitizing; links to apps or scripts ask before opening; in-app updates require an Apple-issued certificate from the same developer.
· Backup: remote copies are no longer deleted when a subfolder is temporarily unreadable; restore works with KMS-encrypted buckets.
· Version history follows files that are renamed or moved.
